## Checklist

- [ ] Linked issue
- [ ] Tests added or updated (`go test -race ./...`)
- [ ] `gofmt -l .` prints nothing and `go vet ./...` is clean
- [ ] Benchmarks attached if this touches the hot path
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under Unreleased
- [ ] Commits signed off (`git commit -s`) and the title is `type: summary`
